items.title: RBLX DEADLINE FRIDAY: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Roblox Corporation Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important August 7 Deadline in Securities Class Action – RBLX
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm reminds Roblox Corporation investors who purchased stock between October 31, 2024 and April 30, 2026 of the August 7, 2026 deadline to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Roblox provided misleading statements about organic growth potential while concealing material adverse facts regarding slowdowns from age verification rollout, reduced on-platform communication, and declining app store ratings.

items.title: ROBLOX DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LEADING AND LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Roblox Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important August 7 Deadline in Securities Class Action – RBLX
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Roblox Corporation, Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc., and Wix.com Ltd. The Roblox lawsuit alleges the company made false statements about organic growth potential while concealing material adverse facts regarding enrollment slowdowns and reduced app store ratings. Investors who purchased shares during specified periods are encouraged to join the class action before the August 7, 2026 deadline.

items.title: ROBLOX DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Roblox Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important August 7 Deadline in Securities Class Action – RBLX
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Roblox Corporation for allegedly providing false and misleading statements about the company's organic growth potential. The lawsuit claims Roblox concealed material adverse facts regarding significant slowdowns in growth rates due to age verification rollout impacts on user engagement and app store ratings. Investors who purchased Roblox common stock between October 31, 2024 and April 30, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with an August 7, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

items.title: RBLX Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Roblox Corporation Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm
items.summary: The Schall Law Firm is seeking investors who purchased Roblox Corporation securities between October 30, 2025 and April 30, 2026 to join a class action lawsuit alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims Roblox made false and misleading statements about its ability to manage age verification risks and forecast business performance, while relying on viral events for growth. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to contact the firm before August 7, 2026.
